notes:
{掲示|けいじ} refers to the public posting or display of information such as announcements, schedules, and results. Also functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掲示|けいじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {掲示|けいじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to post, to display publicly
- ⟦{掲示|けいじ}{板|ばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧: bulletin board
- {掲示|けいじ}⟦{物|ぶつ}→物：noentry⟧: posted notice/material
- {掲示|けいじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to check the notice board
